questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Where the cheese course sits in a French meal
questions.learningObjective: Place the cheese course in a French meal

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: «after the main course and before dessert.» Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: Avec «Think of the classic four-course order.» en téte, quelle option est conforme au texte ?

options.text: after dessert as final course
after the main course and before dessert
before the first course
with the aperitif before the meal

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: the cheese course comes after the main course and before dessert. On that basis "after the main course and before dessert" is the supported choice. Option A ("after dessert as final course") fails because it places cheese after dessert; Option C ("before the first course") fails because it places cheese before the starter; Option D ("with the aperitif before the meal") fails because it places cheese with aperitif.
questions.hint: Think of the classic four-course order.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: The article with a bread term
questions.learningObjective: Choose the article used with a bread term

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: «un pain, masculine singular article with bread.» Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: En appliquant «Choose the article used with a bread term / Check the noun gender first. / The article with a bread term» au fragment, quelle option se justifie ?

options.text: des pain, plural article for singular noun
options.misconception: uses plural for a singular noun

options.text: un pain, masculine singular article with bread
le pain, definite article not requested
une pain, wrong gender for pain

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: pain is masculine, so the indefinite article is un in a bread phrase. On that basis "un pain, masculine singular article with bread" is the supported choice. Option A ("des pain, plural article for singular noun") fails because it uses plural for a singular noun; Option D ("une pain, wrong gender for pain") fails because it assigns feminine gender to pain; Option C ("le pain, definite article not requested") fails because it uses definite instead of indefinite.
